title: Tesar Drive
description: This client wanted to evoke the look at feel of classic mid-century british motorcycle brands such as Norton, Triumph, and Royal Enfield for their line of in-wheel electric motors and transmissions.

title: Nsyte
description: Nsyte, an industrial technology company, operating in the manufacturing space, wanted something different. Colors that stand out among the crowd, an animal mascot to give customers something to attach to, and illustrations that clearly show abstract concepts. This brand included a website, several tutorial animations, and a large conference booth.

title: Tempest
description: This responsive brand system includes custom lettering, a leviathan mascot, and plenty sizes and formats for the companys designers to use in layouts. Six alternative texture backgrounds were also provided, as well as a toned-down colorway for when tennis ball green isnt appropriate.

title: Honest Barber
description: One of my favorite projects. I was getting my hair cut at Little Barber, here in Austin, when I find out my Barber is the owner, and he needs some merch. We had been chatting about cars and exes, and this idea was formed. I never did get a shirt though...

title: Army Futures Command
description: Created for the U.S. Armys Army Futures Command. These Soldiers get up in the morning and put on slacks and a button up, instead of their uniform, to work with entrepreneurs and innovators in the private sector. This responsive design system allowed the rather stodgy Army brand to blend in with the private sector companies they were looking to court. Note: Logo Option 3 in the branding presentation is not my work.

title: Miami
description: Created for an event taking place in Miami, this typeface is directly inspired by the type and architecture of Miami.

title: Candescent
description: This client wanted a logo that felt like the warmth of a campfire. We tossed around lots of fun concepts until we settled on this camping lantern icon. He liked the campfire icon, so I gave it to him as a secondary brand icon to be used in the future.

title: HACKtheMACHINE Unmanned
description: HACKtheMACHINE was a goliath undertaking. Three days of live programming filled with video segments, interviews, a live show, speeches, breaking news, and more. I worked with show runners and the production crew to produce hundreds of assets required to make a show like this work.

title: EkoTots
description: This client, a veteran and single mother, knew her colors and knew she wanted something that felt natural. We iterated over the course of two weeks to make sure everything was perfect for her brand.

title: Project Convergence
description: Project Convergence is an annual DoD event showcasing unmanned capabilities. This logo was created to show each branch coming together on one common problem.
